title: Oozy Spicy Crispy Ackee Pancakes
description: Spicy and crispy ackee pancakes are a comforting norwegian dish that can be made paleo-friendly.

ingredients.name: 300g cooked ackee fruit, drained and mashed
50g raw cashews, soaked overnight and blended until smooth (optional for creaminess)

instructions: In a large bowl, mix coconut flour with cayenne pepper and salt.
Add eggs, ackee, and blended cashews if using. Mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Pour batter onto hot pan in circles about 2 cm thick.
Cook for 1-2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite dips or spreads.
